scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakaar Silai Machine Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the labour board/department
Applicant must not have received a sewing machine or an amount equivalent to its value under any other state scheme
Applicant must not have received benefits under the Chief Minister Cycle Assistance Scheme
Applicant may be employed by an employer or run her own business and must earn a living for herself and her family
benefits_summary: Sewing machines are supplied annually to eligible unorganized women workers of the state.
